rows.text: The Élysée states that M. Jacques CHIRAC received M. Nicolas SARKOZY, 'élu le 6 mai 2007 Président de la République', at the Élysée Palace 'à 11 heures le mercredi 16 mai 2007'.
It states that after their meeting M. Nicolas SARKOZY went to the Salle des Fêtes, where the President of the Constitutional Council proclaimed the official results of the presidential election.
